nodes.title: SG-8.4.1 Rewrite repo-root context.md to the real stack and modules
nodes.body:
Context: context.md is still the README-only draft with 'hello Worldseed', a Traceability index and 13 UNKNOWN placeholders. Desired behavior: it names TypeScript, Phaser 3.90, React, Zustand, Radix, Vitest and Go (backend) and lists only game/src/, game/frontend/src/, game/docs/GDD.md and backend/. Expected result: contextStack, contextDoc and contextPaths tests pass. Why: docs must match the code.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the rewritten context.md, when missingTerms runs with STACK_TERMS, then it returns [] and the text matches /\bGo\b/
- Given the rewritten context.md, when staleTextHits runs and UNKNOWN is searched, then there are no hits
- Given the module table, when contextModulePaths and missingPaths run, then the four required paths are present and all exist


## Scope
- In scope: Repo-root context.md content (Stack, Modules)
- Out of scope: backend/ changes
- Out of scope: Gameplay changes
- Out of scope: Other steps SG-8.4.2 to SG-8.4.5
- Preserve: Existing docsCheck and contextDoc helpers and tests
- Preserve: game/docs/GDD.md


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0
- backend/ (Go) is out of scope
- No test deleted or skipped
- npm test and npm run typecheck pass in game/ and game/frontend/
- No source file over 200 lines


## Definition of done
- contextStack, contextDoc and contextPaths tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None
